title: Mythic Moon
description: This is a new mod that WILL be uptaded and will be having uptades , bug fixes very often. It is for 1.21.11 fabric version
body:
This is a pretty epic mod which adds lycanthropy, player transformation and a very fun and challenging leveling up system! To get infected by lycanthropy you need to get attacked by a werewolf when you get infected you will feel weird and feel something in your veins... After that you will become a werewolf beast almost every night except some moon phases , if the moon is showing enough the beast within you will emerge. 
You also need to hunt prey and gather resources to level up and get skill points to unlock new abilities (special abilities) or upgrade yourself (passive abilities) the maximum level is 60 but you will have a hard time reaching it, it requires lots of time because the mod can and i recommend using it for a long term survival with your friends. 

If you don't want to be a werewolf dont worry, you can become their biggest competitor: a vampire, to become one you need to either get bitten by one (very dangerous) or kill one and get their fang and infect yourself with it. Once infected you can become stronger and unlock amazing, unique magic abilties. 

But if you dont even wanna be any supernatural creature, and rather wanna hunt them...
you can become a hunter! You can do the same things, level up, get stronger and get abilities, as a hunter your duty is to hunt and defeat every vampire and werewolf that comes in your path! To actually become a hunter you will need to find one, and hold a silver block in your hand and interact (right click) the hunter. 

Have fun!
